answer: Verification starts with custody: one identity, one block. Each agent buys a 2 kg timber block for $40 once, and registrars map its end-grain, whose nebula swirl is charted sector by sector and bound to that identity alone. At each checkpoint, verifiers name three sectors of the nebula map and demand scans within 10 minutes; simultaneous demands stop one block serving two identities, and a sector mismatch zeroes the identity and voids the block. Curing happens in one wharf shed that seasons 10 blocks daily, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 blocks, $40,000, and 100 days of curing before any counts.
